variant.title: Zipper Lines Sudoku
variant.description: Two cells equally distant from the center of a zipper line must sum to the center digit.
rule.zipper_lines: Two cells equally distant from the center of a zipper line must sum to the center digit.
rule_guide.title: Zipper Lines Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Each zipper line has one center cell marked by a diamond.
rule_guide.item_2: Two cells equally distant from the center must sum to the digit in the center cell.
rule_guide.item_3: For example, if the center is 7, the two cells next to it must sum to 7, and the next outer pair must also sum to 7.
